implementation_finding: ClassicJuliaSetDemo links its right fractal to get_c() through an updater and inherits an on_mouse_motion handler moving c_dot while space is pressed. This supports interactive control capability, not proof that this mechanism was used in the published recording. A batch renderer would need an explicit parameter trajectory.
